title: VerificationChallenge
description: Short-lived, one-use proof for a particular verified contact or identity link intent.

created_at.description: UTC instant of initial durable creation. Server assigned.

version.description: Starts at 1. Increment exactly once per authoritative mutation.

updated_at.description: UTC instant of the latest authoritative mutation. Server assigned.

principal_id.description: Actor authorized to satisfy the challenge.

contact_id.description: Contact being verified, when purpose is contact verification.

connection_id.description: Identity connector, when purpose is an external account link.

purpose.description: Exact operation to which this challenge is bound.

target_version.description: Version of the contact or principal being verified.

secret_fingerprint.description: Keyed fingerprint of proof. Present only while a challenge is open. No plaintext proof persists.

expires_at.description: Exclusive expiry, default creation plus 15 minutes.

state.description: Current lifecycle state. Mutate only through declared transitions.

x-invariants: Require one contact for contact verification and one connection for account link. Proof fingerprint includes purpose and target.
Five failed attempts revoke the challenge. Expiry is enforced using server time even when persisted state is open.
